user_problem: Multiple supplied assets use calls to action that may conflict with approved audience stage or destination.
unique_output: A map of asset, audience state, CTA text, promised destination, actual supplied destination label, and mismatch.
required_input: Asset copy, audience-stage rules, approved CTAs, destination descriptions, and prohibited transitions.
critical_rule: Do not assume a destination fulfills a promise from its title alone; rely on the supplied description.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is message-asset-reuse-map; this audits CTA progression and destination fit rather than message reuse locations.
acceptance_scenario: Input awareness asset says 'Start trial,' rules allow only 'Learn more,' and destination is a feature overview. Output flags both stage and destination mismatch and selects the approved CTA.
